roles.name: Healer
roles.summary: Strongest healing, with an edge against enemy mages.

roles.name: Attack mage
roles.summary: Offensive magic with better accuracy and bind resistance.

roles.name: Mounted mage
roles.summary: Keeps offensive magic while gaining movement.

roles.name: Swordfighter
roles.summary: Fast sword damage and critical hits to finish fights.

roles.name: Axe bruiser
roles.summary: Strength-driven close combat with a heavy finisher.

roles.name: Archer
roles.summary: Reliable long-range damage and the anti-flier role.

roles.name: Mounted archer
roles.summary: Moves and shoots from new angles across big maps.

roles.name: Armored wall
roles.summary: Holds chokepoints, shields allies and counterattacks.

roles.name: Cavalry
roles.summary: Mounted frontliners with mobility and durability.

roles.name: Flier
roles.summary: Flies over terrain to reach targets others can't.

roles.name: Frontline support
roles.summary: Spear fighter on foot who can also heal nearby allies.

roles.name: Brawler-healer
roles.summary: Fights up close on one turn and heals on the next.

roles.name: Thief and utility
roles.summary: Combat plus locks, chests and exploration.

roles.name: Unique paths
roles.summary: Characters with their own route or special class.

characters.name: Alexandra
characters.why: Mobile flier with improved survivability and reach.

game8.why: High Speed, Dexterity and Luck let her double and dodge easily.

characters.name: Anatolia
characters.why: Contributes on both offense and support turns.

game8.why: Strong Magic, Speed and Dexterity suit a fast, accurate attack mage, and her Black Magic skill makes Ovate a natural start.

characters.name: Aswan
characters.why: Joins in Part III, when retraining costs more than it returns.

game8.why: High Speed and Dexterity let her double and avoid enemies, and her bow-focused personal skill suits these classes.

characters.name: Benditz
characters.why: Mounted ranged attacker who covers large areas.

game8.why: Strong Dexterity and Bow and Riding skill suit the Charioteer path, and his chariot bonus adds accuracy.

characters.name: Bertrand
characters.why: Simple physical package with a heavy finisher.

game8.why: Strong HP, Strength, Speed, Dexterity and Defense make him a frontliner, and Warrior suits his Axe and Brawling skill.

characters.name: Bonaventure
characters.why: Mobile magic attacker.

game8.why: Strong Black and White Magic plus high Magic, Speed and Dexterity growths suit a pure mage from start to finish.

characters.name: Buccar
characters.why: Front-line durability and ally shielding.

game8.why: Spear, Axe, Riding and Heavy Armor strengths with strong HP, Strength and Defense make a durable frontliner; cavalry adds mobility.

characters.name: Cai
characters.why: Stays mounted and turns spear skill into mobile offense.

game8.why: Cai's spear and riding aptitudes suit a cavalry path, and the early classes unlock a mount that leads into the later ones.

characters.name: Catania
characters.why: Speed and precision for finishing kills.

game8.why: High Speed and Dexterity and sword and spear strengths make her a quick, evasive melee unit.

characters.name: Centurio
characters.why: Absorbs enemy turns and hits back hard.

game8.why: High HP, Strength, Dexterity and Defense make him a durable tank that hits hard.

characters.name: Creek
characters.why: Defensive mounted unit that keeps pace on large maps.

game8.why: Balanced Strength, Speed and Dexterity make him a frontliner who dodges well and doubles consistently.

characters.name: Dadao
characters.why: Turns Strength into heavy-hitting damage.

game8.why: Strong HP, Strength and Defense make him a solid tank.

characters.name: Dante
characters.why: Strongest offensive magic route.

game8.why: Build White and Black Magic; low Defense means she should stay at range and support allies with healing.

characters.name: Diego
characters.why: Combat plus lockpicking and searching.

game8.why: High Dexterity makes swords a strong choice, especially with Sword Crit +7 boosting his critical hits.

characters.name: Dietrich
characters.why: Sword critical-hit build. The Blade is his Divine class.
characters.tip: AllThings.How also suggests In Shadow (Rogue) for his evasion, Ever Vigilant (Shido) for his crits, and Overtake (Caladrius) as a mobile finisher.

game8.why: The page favors sword-based infantry classes because Dietrich's sword skill and Answerer pair well with them, and these classes further boost his already high crit rate, speed, and skill growth.

characters.name: Esmeralda
characters.why: Chokepoint defender who protects nearby allies.

game8.why: Strong HP, Strength and Defense growths suit the front line, and this path makes her a mobile, high-Strength cavalry or flying unit.

characters.name: Eshmel
characters.why: Spear pressure, healing and staying power in a lane.

game8.why: Eshmel's innate spear skill preference makes the Sentinel and The Trident skill requirements easy to meet, so the page recommends that promotion path.

characters.name: Fabio
characters.why: Offensive magic without spending ranks on other weapons.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests Ever Vigilant (Shido) to pair his Death spell with crit-focused units.

game8.why: Fabio's high Magic growth suits a Black Magic build, and Druid later adds Speed for Part 3.

characters.name: Fianna
characters.why: Strongest healer route, with a defensive edge against mages.

game8.why: Strong Magic and Resistance make her a good healer, and her personal ability triggers when she heals.

characters.name: Gaitz
characters.why: Maximizes sword offense and finishing burst.

game8.why: Balanced Strength, Speed, Dexterity and Defense growths make him a solid frontline fighter.

characters.name: Goliath
characters.why: Physical wall that protects allies and counterattacks.

game8.why: Strong HP, Strength and Defense make him a durable tank, and his Heavyweight Class ability boosts Build.

characters.name: Guzran
characters.why: Flexible combat plus exploration utility.

game8.why: Balanced HP, Strength, Speed and Dexterity make him a strong frontliner, and sword classes suit his Sword strength.

characters.name: Halvin
characters.why: Reliable long-range damage and anti-flier role.

game8.why: High Speed and Dexterity let her double and avoid enemies.

characters.name: Hong Hua
characters.why: Pure offensive magic with high-impact spells.

game8.why: Her strong Magic, Skill, and Speed growths and Black Magic proficiency make her a natural Ovate.

characters.name: Inyoni
characters.why: Maximizes ranged pressure and anti-flier damage.

game8.why: Strong Strength and Dexterity suit accurate, powerful ranged attacks, and her personal skill only works with bows.

characters.name: Io
characters.why: Durable frontliner with mounted mobility.

game8.why: HP, Dexterity and Defense growths make him sturdy cavalry, and Gladiator early boosts his Strength.

characters.name: Jasmine
characters.why: Counter-focused defense that protects allies.

game8.why: Spear, Axe and Heavy Armor skill suit armored classes, and her counterattack kit fits a defensive role.

characters.name: Jester
characters.why: Fits his fast sword style without splitting training.

game8.why: High Speed and Dexterity help him dodge and double, and a Strength-boosting Specialty class covers his weak Strength.

characters.name: Kiroc
characters.why: Flanks exposed targets and handles doors and chests.

game8.why: Bow skill and strong Speed, Dexterity and Strength make him a fast, evasive archer all game.

characters.name: Klapka
characters.why: Joins in Part III. Keep his class unless a direct upgrade is available.

game8.why: He's locked into Guardian and can't change class; it suits his lance and White Magic strengths.

characters.name: Leda
characters.why: Stay a Dancer most of the game. The Apsara is her Divine class for a support slot.

game8.why: High Speed lets her dodge and double; Hunter and Archer raise her Speed growth, and Dancer or The Apsara let her give allies an extra turn.

characters.name: Lillian
characters.why: Highly accurate ranged damage and anti-flier role.

game8.why: Bow and infantry aptitudes and high Dexterity make her a reliable archer.

characters.name: Loretta
characters.why: Concentrates training on swords for immediate damage.

game8.why: Strong Speed and Resistance let her evade, double enemies and absorb magic hits.

characters.name: Ludia
characters.why: Fast follow-up attacks that end fights quickly.

game8.why: Strong Speed and Dexterity let her dodge and double, and her Sword strength pairs well with her Speed.

characters.name: Lysander
characters.why: Fast, aggressive spear cavalry.

game8.why: High Speed growth suits cavalry or flying classes, and this path covers his modest Strength, Defense and Dexterity.

characters.name: Majide
characters.why: Axes match his Strength, with a boss-damage option.

game8.why: Strong Axe and Gauntlet skill and high HP and Strength suit a hard-hitting frontliner.

characters.name: Mikaela
characters.why: Efficient axe build with a strong finisher.

game8.why: Strong Strength and axe growths suit melee; riding and flying are weaknesses, so mounted classes trade some power for mobility.

characters.name: Mu
characters.why: Simple, high-output physical role with burst options.

game8.why: Boosted growths and Sword, Axe and Brawling strengths make The Eternal her best end point; Warrior's Blood rewards switching weapons.

characters.name: Nathan
characters.why: Brings physical pressure with mobility and durability.

game8.why: Balanced HP, Strength, Dexterity and Defense plus Riding and Heavy Armor strengths make a mobile, durable tank.

characters.name: Nezha
characters.why: Rewards attacking first and ending fights quickly.

game8.why: Good Strength, Speed and Dexterity make him a strong physical frontliner.

characters.name: Ninae
characters.why: Pure support with strong healing and anti-mage value.

game8.why: Diviner and Priest build her White and Black Magic, and spear training at the Arena qualifies her for Sentinel and then The Trident.

characters.name: Noctula
characters.why: Straightforward brawler with a heavy finisher.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests In Shadow (Rogue) because Noctula dodges well.

game8.why: Strong Axe and Gauntlet skill and Infantry aptitude make Noctula a physical frontliner; Warrior comes easily.

characters.name: Nuzzuo
characters.why: Exploits weak points and covers exploration.

game8.why: Strong Strength, Speed and Dexterity make an accurate attacker who doubles and dodges, and his Bow and Sword skill fit this path.

characters.name: Nydine
characters.why: Survivability through flying mobility.

game8.why: Axe and Riding strengths and cavalry-only abilities make her a natural mounted unit all game.

characters.name: Olympia
characters.why: Dedicated healer with stronger recovery.

game8.why: High Magic growth, a White Magic strength and versatile spells make her a strong fit for The Avatar.

characters.name: Orchel
characters.why: Strength-driven close combat with high finishing power.

game8.why: Solid Strength, Magic, Defense and Resistance growths make her a tanky mixed attacker.

characters.name: Peppe
characters.why: Mobile archer who keeps changing firing angles.

game8.why: Good Speed and Dexterity let him double and dodge, though low Strength limits his damage.

characters.name: Peter
characters.why: Dedicated archer with reliable long-range hits.

game8.why: Peter's bow and infantry skill boons and strong Dexterity growth make a bow-focused path with hit-boosting abilities the best fit.

characters.name: Seteth
characters.why: Aggressive flier that bypasses most terrain.

game8.why: Balanced growths leaning to HP, Strength and Dexterity, and a Spear strength, suit these classes.

characters.name: Sha Lan
characters.why: Maximizes her value as a healer.

game8.why: Build White Magic early for healing, then train Spear and Gauntlet to unlock Sentinel and The Godhand.

characters.name: Simon
characters.why: Direct physical pressure with a finisher for tough enemies.

game8.why: Sword, Axe and Infantry strengths favor infantry paths, and Swordmaster's +20 Speed growth covers his low Speed.

characters.name: Sirocco
characters.why: Keeps offensive magic while gaining mobility.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests In Shadow (Rogue) for his evasion and Ever Vigilant (Shido) for his crits.

game8.why: Works best as a mage attacking from range to offset low Defense and Resistance; Troubadour and High Savant raise his Movement.

characters.name: Sofia
characters.why: Maximizes healing output.

game8.why: High Magic, a White Magic strength and healing abilities make her best as a healer.

characters.name: Tahonia
characters.why: Joins in Part III, too late to start a new weapon path.

game8.why: Strong Strength and Skill growths and gauntlet skill suit Battle Master, which adds +25 Strength and +5 Skill.

characters.name: Talimun
characters.why: Uses his existing sword training for kill potential.

game8.why: Magic, Dexterity and Speed suit a fast, accurate mage, and staying on foot keeps his Authority strength and battalions usable.

characters.name: Theodora
characters.why: Balanced durability, damage and support on foot.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests Crescendo (Archer) to shore up her accuracy. The Trident Divine class doesn't stack well with her Mahado's Right Arm.

game8.why: Early Gladiator and Armored Ornius Rider training builds her Strength, Speed, and Defense, and her Spear and White Magic preferences suit the Guardian-to-Trident path.

characters.name: Tialla
characters.why: Support healer with strong recovery and anti-caster value.

game8.why: Her strong White and Black Magic, plus Diviner and Priest boosting her Magic and Resistance growths, make a mounted mage path that leads to Valkyrium.

characters.name: Tobias
characters.why: Close-range Strength with an answer to bulky targets.
characters.tip: AllThings.How suggests Crescendo (Archer) to make up for his low accuracy.

game8.why: High Strength and decent Defense make him a frontliner, and his Axe, Riding and Heavy Armor strengths suit armored cavalry.

characters.name: Troy
characters.why: Combines brawling offense with healing.

game8.why: Her strong Strength, Magic, and Speed growths make her a versatile attacker who can avoid hits and double often, especially with Gauntlets.

characters.name: Ultand
characters.why: Front-line fighter who can also heal nearby allies.

game8.why: Her spear skill and White Magic make Guardian and Sentinel the strongest late-game fits, so her class should focus on White Magic.

characters.name: Ursula
characters.why: Strong bow damage and anti-flier role. Shadow Seeker only for utility.

game8.why: High Speed and Dexterity help her dodge and land critical hits.

characters.name: Yang Jie
characters.why: Covers both melee combat and healing.

game8.why: His White Magic strength and 40% Magic growth make him a healer, and this path raises his Magic and healing.

characters.name: Zarcone
characters.why: Endgame class for an axe specialist.

game8.why: Brigand, Warrior and Swordmaster cover his low Strength and Speed, while high Dexterity and Hatchet Man suit axes.

masterUnlocks.Swordmaster: Mars' Temple: 1 Lazanibata (Giant's Mount). Favor quest: find the glowing yellow orb in Nemea Cavern.
masterUnlocks.High Savant: Smyrnos' Temple: 1 Almamet (Dubhe Ridge). Favor quest: learn Ice from the Fimbulvetr Tome, burn the flames in Iapetus Cavern, take the yellow orb.
masterUnlocks.Valkyrium: Jurah's Temple: 1 Jyoppa (Klytius Plains). Favor quest: use the item near the pillars on Dagsion Summit.
masterUnlocks.Bow Knight: Kalla's Temple: 1 Ginji (Napier Woods, Amalthea). Favor quest: collect rare sandalwood at The Brigadier Pass.
masterUnlocks.Great Knight: Credna's Temple: 1 Lightstar (Midnight Turn, Lambath). Favor quest: find the item in the Dragon Bone Tangle dungeon.
masterUnlocks.War Monk: Aurora's Temple: 1 Ginji (Napier Woods, Amalthea). Favor quest: gather 5 Angelica.
